records.manualArithmetic: Area 4 cm² and mean speed 6 cm/s give 24 cm³/s = 24 mL/s; at 7 cm/s the result is 28 mL/s. Exact clock distances for (v,t)=(0,6),(1,3),(7,3),(12,6) are 0,3,21,72 cm; derived volumes are 0,12,84,288 mL. Zero speed transports nothing. Integrated volumes are independent calculations, not asserted DOM fields.
records.pedagogicalReview: Frozen independent mathematical primary and current instrument rubric precede this raw reading. All 160 current cases, both editions and 66 complete PNGs read; 8 fallback and 16 native historical witnesses resolved only on FE5D. Canonical eight-profile examples per edition are explicit subsets. Side projection can touch rear tracers; ray/draw-order/raster evidence establishes visible tips, not silhouette separation. Private author preview remains separate.
records.physicalAssumptions: Stationary incompressible flow through equal fixed cross-sections of 4 cm². The displayed speed is the section mean; schematic tracers follow this mean and are not a resolved viscous velocity profile. Speed is held constant during each clock trial. Both directional arrows are offset in depth only for legibility; their x/y displacement, direction and common speed scale are unchanged. A periodic tracer pattern after 72 cm does not imply zero transport.

actualAssignedTasks.prompt: Imposta «Velocità media» su 6 cm/s. Quale valore ottieni per «Portata volumetrica»?
actualAssignedTasks.worked: Q = A v media; A = 4 cm². 4 × 6 = 24 mL/s.

actualAssignedTasks.prompt: Un tubo di area 4 cm² porta un liquido a velocità media 7 cm/s. Quanti millilitri entrano nel recipiente ogni secondo?
actualAssignedTasks.worked: Q = A v media; A = 4 cm². 4 × 7 = 28 mL/s.
